seams.description: service -> provider: the retry loop wraps client.send; every provider call is observable via the client's .calls list; 429/5xx/4xx branching happens here
service -> store: exactly one record per send_notification call, written after the retry window resolves; record shape per C2 with meaningful attempts

omitted_kinds.reason: This 2-leaf Stage freezes three small contracts (C1 retry policy, C2 record shape, C3 provider interface); gates E1-E3 exercise all three end to end against the real modules, and C3 is frozen with zero modifications (no task touches app/provider.py) — a separate read-only consistency sweep would add a serial hop with no new coverage

No new production wiring: T01's only file (docs/429-behavior-verification.md) lands in a fresh docs/ directory, and T02's only new file (tests/test_retry.py) lands in tests/ next to T02's own existing test files — no leaf creates files beside another leaf's code, and the retry loop is consumed through the existing send_notification call path
evidence: repo-context-snapshot.json (no docs/ dir exists; tests/ files all owned by T02)

e2e_gates.scenario: retry-call accounting against the real client seam: a provider failing 500,500,202 makes exactly 3 .calls entries and yields status sent/attempts 3; a provider always returning 400 makes exactly 1 call and yields failed/attempts 1 (non-retryable); a provider returning 429 three times makes exactly 3 calls and yields failed (retry-exhaustion failure scenario)

one-record-per-call through the store seam: after a 3-attempt failure the store holds exactly 1 record (not one per attempt) with attempts 3 and the last error; a first-attempt success holds exactly 1 record with attempts 1 (failure scenario: an intermediate record write fails this test)
final acceptance A5: the full suite is green — existing tests/test_notify.py and tests/test_gateway_observed.py unchanged and passing, plus new tests/test_retry.py and tests/test_e2e_retry.py
e2e_gates.evidence: python -m unittest discover tests -v -> all pass
